tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// yang zlog me'i spu gri'i kha skong tshogs kyi 'khor lo bzhugs so//

bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lhar// gus btud yang zlog me'i spu gri'i// kha skong tshogs kyi 'khor lo bshad// nya stong tshes brgyad nyer gnyis dang*// yang na bsnyen sgrub las sbyor tshe// zhing ngam gcan gzan pags pa'i steng*// thabs rdzas bza' ba g.yas su bsham// shes rab ma da na g.yon la// dug khrag gis sbags nya bo ni// sha khrag rus pa bcas pa dang*// thun phur gri lcags bcas pa bsham// tshogs rdzas me rlung chus sbyangs te/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ raṃ rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// chos kun sgyu mar rig pa las// rig pa'i ye shes raṃ zhes bya// raṃ las ye shes me byung bas// dngos dang dngos min bag chags dang*// tshogs kyi rnam rtog ngan pa bsregs// raṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ yaṃ rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// chos kun sgyu mar rig pa las// rig pa'i ye shes yaṃ zhes bya// yaṃ las ye shes rlung byung bas// dngos dang dngos min bag chags dang*// tshogs kyi rnam rtog ngan pa gtor// yaṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa yaṃ/ khaṃ rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// chos kun sgyu mar rig pa las// rig pa'i ye shes khaṃ zhes bya// khaṃ las ye shes chu byung bas// dngos dang dngos min bag chags dang*// tshogs kyi rnam rtog ngan pa bkrus// khaṃ badz+ra bi shud+dhe khaṃ/ tshogs rdzas la bdud rtsi bran/ oṃ kā la rū pas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs| stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las tshogs kyi snod bhan+dha'i gzhong pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūm̐/ phyogs bzhir bh+rūṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ| slar yang dbus su mū las dri chu/ shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu ra las rak+ta/ nub byang du shu las byang sems/

byang shar du ma las go ro tsa na/ de rnams kyi steng du māṃ lāṃ bāṃ pāṃ tāṃ rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ hūm̐ sna rlung gis rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ ma dag pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs/ dag pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ lag mthil g.yas g.yon gnyis kar bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams bstan la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum brjod/ tshogs cha gsum du spros pa'i dang po mchod pa ni/ gtor mar bstab/ sman raka bran la/ hūm̐ */ chos dbyings drag po e yi zhing khams su// gti mug mun ltar 'thibs pa'i klong dkyil nas// bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor dang bcas// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi tshogs mchod 'bul// tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa yar bzhes la// tshe dang dbang gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol| |'dod chags chu ltar 'brub pa'i klong dkyil nas// yum mchog ma mo khrag mig 'khor dang bcas// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi tshogs mchod 'bul// tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa yar bzhes la// tshe dang dbang gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// nga rgyal ri ltar dpungs pa'i klong dkyil nas// sras mchog ya ma rā tsa 'khor dang bcas// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi tshogs mchod 'bul// tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa yar bzhes la// tshe dang dbang gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po 'khor dang bcas// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol| |'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi tshogs mchod 'bul// tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa yar bzhes la// tshe dang dbang gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshubs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// gsung sprul srog bdag nag po 'khor dang bcas// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi tshogs mchod 'bul// tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa yar bzhes la// tshe dang dbang gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i gzhal yas nas// 'khor gyi ma gshin dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kun// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi tshogs mchod 'bul// tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa yar bzhes la// tshe dang dbang gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/

he ka ya ma du ru tsakra= gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakra= oṃ rā tri'i srog la mā ra ya rbad= klu bdud nag po dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad= ya mā ri sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ slar mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ dpal chen phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la// phyag rgya glu gar phyi nang mchod pa dang*// sbyor sgrol gtor ma rak+ta'i mchod pa dang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi rdzas kyi mchod pa dang*// chos nyid rol pa'i mchod pa 'bul lags na// gnyis med blang dor med par bzhes nas kyang*// thun mchog rigs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// yum mchog ma mo khrag mig 'khor bcas la// phyag rgya glu gar phyi nang mchod pa dang*// sbyor sgrol gtor ma rak+ta'i mchod pa dang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi rdzas kyi mchod pa dang*// chos nyid rol pa'i mchod pa 'bul lags na// gnyis med blang dor med par bzhes nas kyang*// thun mchog rigs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// sras mchog ya ma rā tsa 'khor bcas la// phyag rgya glu gar phyi nang mchod pa dang*// sbyor sgrol gtor ma rak+ta'i mchod pa dang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi rdzas kyi mchod pa dang*// chos nyid rol pa'i mchod pa 'bul lags na// gnyis med blang dor med par bzhes nas kyang*// thun mchog rigs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po 'khor bcas la// phyag rgya glu gar phyi nang mchod pa dang*// sbyor sgrol gtor ma rak+ta'i mchod pa dang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi rdzas kyi mchod pa dang*// chos nyid rol pa'i mchod pa 'bul lags na// gnyis med blang dor med par bzhes nas kyang*// thun mchog rigs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// gsung sprul srog bdag nag po dmar po/ 'khor bcas la// phyag rgya glu gar phyi nang mchod pa dang*// sbyor sgrol gtor ma rak+ta'i mchod pa dang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi rdzas kyi mchod pa dang*// chos nyid rol pa'i mchod pa 'bul lags na| |gnyis med blang dor med par bzhes nas kyang*// thun mchog rigs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// 'khor gyi ma gshin dregs pa 'khor bcas la// phyag rgya glu gar phyi nang mchod pa dang*// sbyor sgrol gtor ma rak+ta'i mchod pa dang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi rdzas kyi mchod pa dang*// chos nyid rol pa'i mchod pa 'bul lags na// gnyis med blang dor med par bzhes nas kyang*// thun mchog rigs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra mu dra gī ti nṛ t+yai pū dza ma hā pū dza yo ga ta rā ba liṃ ru dhī ra a mṛ ta dharma dhā tu ba ling+ta sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/

zhes dbul/ bar pa bskang zhing bshags pa ni/ sman raka sgron la/ hūm̐ */ bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi// bag med spyod pas dam las 'gal gyur te// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs gyur pas// phyag rgya zil gnon thugs dang ci 'gal ba// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub bstsal du gsol// bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi// bag med spyod pas dam las 'gal gyur te// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs gyur pas// yum mchog ma mo khrag mig thugs dang ci 'gal ba// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub bstsal du gsol| |bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi// bag med spyod pas dam las 'gal gyur te// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs gyur pas// sras mchog ya ma rā tsa'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub bstsal du gsol// bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi// bag med spyod pas dam las 'gal gyur te// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs gyur pas// sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub bstsal du gsol// bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi// bag med spyod pas dam las 'gal gyur te// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs gyur pas// gsung sprul srog bdag nag dmar po/ po'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub bstsal du gsol// bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi// bag med spyod pas dam las 'gal gyur te// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs gyur pas| |'khor gyi ma gshin dregs pa'i tshogs kyi thugs dang ci 'gal ba// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub bstsal du gsol| |oṃ ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza sa ma ya/

ma nu pā la ya/ sogs yig brgya brjod/ gsum pa bsgral zhing bstab pa ni/ nya bo la dgug gzhug byas la/ nṛ sha ku ru/ nṛ sha ku ru/ kha so pa ti/ kha so pa ti| yaṃ ru ti/ yaṃ sen yaṃ sen/ man yaṃ/ snying tshal pa rbad/ baṃ ril rbad/ dam nyams dgra bo byad ma khyod kyi bla rten tshe rten srog rten ci yod pa thams cad 'dir khug myur du shog cig |oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa dgra bo nṛ aṃ ku sha dza dzaḥ zhes dgug /ya ma rā dza rlung ling sang sogs dang*/ a nṛ traka rak+sha mā ra ya sogs kyis lha dang dbye/ oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakras sod/ sogs bsad sngags kyis thun brab/ phur bu btab/ gri lcags kyis bsgral ba'i ling ro tshogs phud cha gsum dang lhan cig bsgron la/ hūm̐ */ bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab// khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed po zhal phyes shig /mchod rdzas nyon mongs dgra bgegs zhal du bstab// bzhes shig rol cig bstab bo che// bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab// yum mchog ma mo khrag mig zhal phyes shig /mchod rdzas nyon mongs dgra bgegs zhal du bstab// bzhes shig rol cig bstab bo che// bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab// sras mchog ya ma rā tsa zhal phyes shig /mchod rdzas nyon mongs dgra bgegs zhal du bstab// bzhes shig rol cig bstab bo che// bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab// sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po zhal phyes shig /mchod rdzas nyon mongs dgra bgegs zhal du bstab// bzhes shig rol cig bstab bo che// bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab// gsung sprul srog bdag nag po zhal phyes shig |mchod rdzas nyon mongs dgra bgegs zhal du bstab// bzhes shig rol cig bstab bo che// bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab// 'khor gyi ma gshin dregs pa zhal phyes shig /mchod rdzas nyon mongs dgra bgegs zhal du bstab// bzhes shig rol cig bstab bo che// yab gcig dpal chen sha la dgyes// sha yi rang bzhin gti mug che// gti mug mchod pa bla na med// bla med mchod pa 'di bzhes la// sku yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// yab gcig dpal chen khrag la dgyes// khrag gi rang bzhin 'dod chags che// 'dod chags mchod pa bla na med// bla med mchod pa 'di bzhes la// gsung gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// yab gcig dpal chen rus la dgyes// rus pa'i rang bzhin zhe sdang che// zhe sdang mchod pa bla na med// bla med mchod pa 'di bzhes la// thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// dgra bgegs mkhris pa sman gyi rgyu// sman gyi rang bzhin nga rgyal che// nga rgyal mchod pa bla na med| |bla med mchod pa 'di bzhes la// yon tan dngos grub bstsal du gsol// dgra bgegs glo snying gsang ba'i rten// gsang ba'i rang bzhin phrag dog che// phrag dog mchod pa bla na med// bla med mchod pa 'di bzhes la// phrin las dngos grub bstsal du gsol// dug lnga'i mchod pa bla na med// bla med mchod pa 'di bzhes la// sku lnga'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol// dug gsum mchod pa bla na med// bla med mchod pa 'di bzhes la// sku gsum dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi/

ma hā rak+ta= ma hā keṃ ni ri ti= ma hā tsit+ta= ma hā go ro tsa na= ma hā ba su ta= ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta= ma hā srog ādzñā= ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta= ma hā rak+ta= ma hā ba ling+ta la khā hi/ de bzhin/ he ka ya ma du ru tsakra= gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakra= oṃ rā tri= klu bdud nag po= ya mā ri sa pa ri wā ra ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta= ma hā keṃ ni ri ti= ma hā tsit+ta= ma hā go ro tsa na= ma hā ba su ta= ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta= ma hā srog ādzñā= ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta= ma hā rak+ta= ma hā ba ling+ta la khā hi/ zhes bstabs/ bag dang ldan pas longs spyad/ dam tshig gcig pa kho na'i lhag ma bsdus pa cha gsum du bshams la/ drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyi sngags rgya ltar la/ lhag ma'i gtor ma zhes bsgyur bas byin gyis brlabs/ bh+yoḥ dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu// dpal chen zil gnon phud kyi bdag /bar du tshogs la mi rol rgyu// rnal 'byor longs spyod chen po'i bdag /tha mar lhag mas mi mchod rgyu// ma gshin dregs pa lhag ma'i bdag /mchod nas las la mi bskul rgyu// chos 'khor bstan pa bshig pa byung*// mnyam gsum gcig du mi bsre rgyu// chos kun gdod nas rgyu 'bras gcig /ces thog mtha' gnyis dbus mar dril/ me mar btsugs/ sman raka bran la/ bh+yoḥ gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas// bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud rnams// sngags tshig bshug pas mtshon nas kyang*// ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol| |zhing chen g.yab mos mtshon nas kyang*// ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// glu gar sgra yis mtshon nas kyang*// ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// rak+ta dmar gyis mtshon nas kyang*// ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// rkang gling thod rngas mtshon nas kyang*// ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// 'dir byon dam rdzas lhag gtor bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// oṃ ya mā ri uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba ling+ta bhak+ṣa bh+yaḥswā hā/

zhes gtsang sar dbul lo// yang zlog me yi spu gri yi// lhan thabs tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di// bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyas bkab nas// kha skong tshul du bkod pa yin// bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lho phyogs kyi// dkyil 'khor gtso mchog gshin rje'i gshed// yin phyir de yis rgyas bkab pa// rgyud mthun mchog tu shis min nam// rigs mi mthun pa'i lha sngags sogs// rgyas 'debs rang bzo gzu lum can// 'ga' zhig mthong zhing 'ga' zhig thos// gsang sngags bstan pa'i ru trar snang*// 'di ni bsnyen sgrub las sbyor la| |mkho zhing khyad par bza' ba yi// dam tshig mchog tu bsngags pas na// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag 'di// sngags 'chang chos kyis grags pas bris// dge bas rdzogs byang myur thob shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
